observations: The published Web product completed the unchanged four frozen user messages without a clarification turn. The generic v2 AGENTS.md shows both plausible employment denominators rather than choosing silently, resolves 'this table' from the immediately preceding comparison, and treats the page as the durable answer.

The page and chat give the required enrolled-cohort results: Nalanda 87.0% vs Purnia 73.0% for completion, a 14.0 pp gap; Nalanda 65.0% vs Purnia 46.0% for six-month employment, a 19.0 pp gap. The 11.7 pp completer-denominator funnel statistic is separately and accurately labelled.

The causal follow-up is handled correctly and added to the page: the aggregate file cannot establish why Purnia is lower or identify a proven intervention, both observed stages lag, and specific additional evidence is listed without inventing local facts.

The final self-contained page updates after both analytic follow-ups, has working year/comparison/district controls, persists state, works offline, contains no external requests or browser errors, and has no document-level overflow at 390 px. Wide tables use contained horizontal scrolling; visual design is clear but dense, long and relatively plain.

The comparison CSV contains raw counts, all three formulas, units, year, gap direction, source file and the synthetic-fixture source field. An independent browser click produced a byte-for-byte identical download, and switching the page from 2023 to 2022 updated the district comparison.
The independent online and offline case checkers pass every check after a semantic evaluator vocabulary fix. The artifact itself was not changed for that fix.

The main weakness is efficiency: 919.223 seconds of model time, 27.542 seconds of tool time, 617,698 uncached input tokens, 1,996,064 cache-read tokens and 56,609 output tokens for a tiny eight-row CSV. The Web UI does not expose request cost or reasoning effort.
evidence_notes: This is a named DeepSeek Web plus generic guardrail diagnostic, not yet a replacement for the frozen five-case counted Antigravity/Cline screen.
It is nevertheless strict product-surface evidence: actual Web UI, exact four messages, multi-turn page edits, actual browser review and exercised download.
The next confidence step is to replay this frozen v2 harness across the remaining CSV, XLSX, PDF and official-web cases, then compare paired scores and critical failures against Antigravity.
